title: HyQuRP: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network with rotational and permutational equivariance
summary: Group-equivariant quantum machine learning has emerged as a promising paradigm by incorporating symmetry into quantum models. However, constructing models simultaneously equivariant to both rotational and permutational symmetries in a principled manner remains a bottleneck. In this work, we develop a general framework for dual-equivariant gates under rotations and permutations and analyze the dimension of the resulting gate space using group representation theory.
